findings.evidence: The proof establishes that F(Λ)=E_A(f⁻¹(Λ)) is a PVM, but does not establish that F is regular before invoking uniqueness to identify it with the spectral PVM of f(A). The cited thm-spectral-theorem-for-unbounded-self-adjoint-operators gives uniqueness among regular PVMs. Regularity follows because each scalar F-measure is finite Borel on ℝ; cite thm-locally-finite-borel-measures-are-regular-when-open-sets-are-sigma-compact and add the prerequisite, or prove regularity locally. Clause (c) is unproved as written; clause (a), used by the assigned joint-PVM criterion, is unaffected.

Clause (c) requires unit norm and f′(t₀)≠0 but does not require Aψ(t₀)∈D(K). The gap closes using the cited weak-form Robertson inequality without product-domain assumptions, ΔKΔA ≥ |Im⟨Aψ,Kψ⟩|, together with f′=−2 Im⟨Aψ,Kψ⟩/ℏ.
